in_sanskrit.name: सुधिर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is endowed with virtues, good qualities and wisdom. A person who is pure in mind, body and speech. A person who is free from all impurities and possesses good character.

in_hindi.name: सुधिर
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who alleviates suffering, one who removes hardships.

in_tamil.name: சுதிர
in_tamil.long_meaning: A person who is good, virtuous, and has wisdom. One who is free from all impurities and possesses good character. A person who alleviates suffering and removes hardships for others.

in_telugu.name: శుధిర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is virtuous, good, pure, clear, and bright. A person who is endowed with good qualities and wisdom. A person who is free from all impurities and possesses good character. A person who alleviates suffering and removes hardships for others.

in_marathi.name: Sudhir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good conduct, virtuous
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudhir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sudhir means 'having good conduct'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sudh' which means 'pure' and 'hir' meaning 'conduct'. In Hindu mythology, Sudhir is a name given to virtuous and wise individuals.
